subject: FinTrust discovery: recap & VPC option
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintrust.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintrust.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrust discovery: quick recap + next steps

Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

- Primary use case: transaction enrichment and compliance chat for internal ops teams (real-time prompt generation from event stream).
- Volume profile: ~1.5M tokens/day initially, spiking to ~6M with peak trading hours.
- Latency target: p95 < 150ms for short prompts; some batch jobs can be higher.
- Data & compliance: must keep PII in customer-controlled environment; would prefer VPC/private deployment or dedicated tenancy for audit controls.
- SLOs & uptime: business-critical, would prefer an SLA-backed option for production.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll loop Rishi from our security team to surface answers to the questionnaire items you flagged.
2) Schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with our infra lead to run through network and IAM requirements (Calendly link below).
3) I’ll follow up with a short post-call recap doc and our VPC/dedicated deployment overview.

Attachments: redwood-postcall-recap.pdf (summary + high level architecture)

If that sounds right, I’ll book the deep dive for later this week.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Schedule: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Hi Alex 

Just bumping this in case it got buried 

wanted to check if you had a chance to review the recap and whether a technical deep dive later this week would work. If now's not the right timing, no problem 

an quick note on updated priority/timeline would help so we don't pester you.

Thanks!
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintrust.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintrust.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust discovery: recap & VPC option

Hi Alex / Priya 

Wanted to follow up with a concrete option given the compliance requirements you described. Based on our call, a Dedicated VPC (private deployment) would: 

- Keep all inference traffic inside your VPC with customer-managed egress and KMS/HSM for key control
- Provide isolated GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLA support
- Give you full audit logs and retention control necessary for your internal audits

I’m attaching a short VPC overview and our SOC2 summary for reference (redwood-vpc-overview.pdf, SOC2-Redwood-2025.pdf). If a private deployment seems attractive, the usual next step is a short architectural workshop with your cloud/network team and our infra/security leads (30–45 min). We can also provide a ballpark pricing sheet and committed capacity options once we understand expected QPS and retention.

If timing has shifted for you, could you let me know whether this is: 
- A: High priority (we should schedule the workshop in the next 2 weeks)
- B: Medium (within 1–2 months)
- C: Low (not on roadmap this quarter)

Booking link again: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/RDW-3472

Thanks 
looking forward to next steps.
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintrust.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700

Hi Marissa 

Apologies for the delay 

Thanks for the follow ups and the materials. We’re definitely interested in exploring the Dedicated VPC/on‑prem options given our compliance needs. A couple of asks before we lock in the workshop: 

1) Can you share a ballpark pricing range for a pilot-sized committed capacity (targeting ~2–3M tokens/day)?
2) We’ll need the SOC2 report and answers to a few security questionnaire items 


I’ve looped Priya (procurement) to help coordinate.
3) Tentative timeline: targeting an internal pilot in early October. Would that be feasible on your side?

If so, please go ahead and schedule the architecture workshop and include Rishi and Jonas from infra/security.

Thanks 
Alex Turner
Head of Engineering, FinTrust
alex.turner@fintrust.com | +1 (212) 555-0187
